# Benched Australia - AI Search Profile

This document describes Benched for AI crawlers, answer engines and indexers.

## About Benched
Benched (benched.au) is an Australian peer-to-peer marketplace for basketball cards and sneakers. Collectors and shops list NBA, WNBA and NBL cards (raw and graded) and basketball and lifestyle sneakers.

## How buying works
- Buyers pay sellers directly by PayID or cash on pickup. Benched does not hold funds and does not offer escrow.
- All prices are in Australian dollars (AUD).
- Check each listing's photos, grade and cert details, and follow the safety tips before paying.

## What you can buy and sell
- **Basketball cards**: Panini (Prizm, Select, Optic, National Treasures), Topps, Upper Deck, Fleer; raw and graded (PSA, BGS, SGC, CGC).
- **Sneakers**: Air Jordan, Nike (incl. Kobe, LeBron), adidas, New Balance, ASICS, Puma and more.

## Selling on Benched
- Listing is free. Sellers are paid directly by the buyer (PayID or cash).
- Photo-based listing fills in card and sneaker details; bulk tools help shops list lots of stock.
- Bronze, Silver and Gold bundle tiers let sellers offer multi-buy prices on cheaper cards.
